bans.brief: Violent Outburst came straight back into Living End, now in 75% of its lists. Eldrazi Bloodchief Combo gained most after May 18, rising to 6.5%. The shares settled after 75 days.

Boros Energy fell from 17% to 12% of top finishes after the Phlage ban. Eldrazi Bloodchief Combo gained most, rising from 1.3% to 6.5%. Amulet Titan rebuilt around The Mycosynth Gardens, now in 95% of its lists.
